comment: AGOS Business Experiments. Every significant change is an experiment: hypothesis, metrics, duration, then a decision (continue / expand / rollback) based on measured evidence. AGOS learns scientifically, not vibes.

experiments.hypothesis: For AEGIBIT, glossary pages increase authority and measurable business outcomes more effectively than our alternative uses of the same production time (general blog articles).
experiments.startCondition: Founder approves coverage-glossary; measurement window opens at first page indexation.
experiments.comparator: general blog articles produced by the existing daily content pipeline over the same window
